name: default
description: Card list (控え室) as of 2026-09, measured on 2000x923 screenshots where a card is 130x130px. The 128px thumbnail/chara art is scaled to cover the whole card; the rarity frame (top/right/bottom, ~5px), attribute icon, stars, master rank badge and the dark 'Lv.xx' bar (spanning the card width 5px above the bottom) are drawn over it. card_to_art fitted with `calibrate` on 80 verified crops; with the frame strips masked, mean NCC vs the official art is 0.990 (0.796 with the original guess).
